config.policy: Bounded diagnostic only: fixed training subsamples, same initial southern-canonical models and all 41 native channels. No S/N training cut. Non-training test-role development evaluations require any band at >=5 sigma. Evaluate covariance update and candidate tolerance, not final independent validation. Production config/model remain unchanged.
